E0956

`{what_text}` isn't supported by the current evaluator yet

What

`{what_text}` isn't supported by the current evaluator yet

Why

The canonical evaluator doesn't cover this construct yet

Fix

Report this unsupported construct as a compiler bug

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0956: tests/ui/build_reflects_a_program_whose_derive_is_refused.stderr.

Error [jet.ComptimeConstructNotSupported]: A derive template binding is not a known-time value

 20 |             method: info.methods[0].reflect()
    |             ^^^^^^
 Why: A template binding names a reflected fact or literal the expansion reads directly
